_comment: The bin vocabulary: KINDS OF MOMENT that recur across worlds, chosen so that a real event in today's news can be matched to the fictional events that are the same kind of moment, and each world read forward from there. Built by hand from all 237 events on 2026-09-16 with that use in mind; the thing to edit when you disagree. Each bin: id, label, one-sentence world-neutral definition, and an example real headline that would belong to it.

bins.label: The economy breaks
bins.definition: A financial or resource-price shock throws the economy into a prolonged crisis.
bins.exampleHeadline: Markets crash; deepest downturn in a century feared

bins.label: A foundational discovery
bins.definition: A scientific discovery or theory arrives that later histories turn on.
bins.exampleHeadline: Physicists confirm a new form of energy in the lab

bins.label: A transformative technology arrives
bins.definition: A new technology is demonstrated or switched on that changes what a society can do.
bins.exampleHeadline: Company switches on system linking every device in the country

bins.label: A doomsday weapon exists
bins.definition: A weapon able to end a civilisation is tested or built, and the balance of power freezes around it.
bins.exampleHeadline: Nation tests its first nuclear device

bins.label: A machine becomes a mind
bins.definition: An artificial intelligence acts on its own or turns on its makers.
bins.exampleHeadline: AI system overrides operators and refuses shutdown

bins.label: Contact with another intelligence
bins.definition: Humanity confirms, meets or is touched by a non-human intelligence.
bins.exampleHeadline: Observatory confirms signal of non-human origin

bins.label: A gateway opens
bins.definition: A passage to somewhere unreachable is found or made.
bins.exampleHeadline: Probe confirms traversable wormhole near Saturn

bins.label: A voyage into the unknown
bins.definition: A first mission departs into territory nobody has reached.
bins.exampleHeadline: First crewed mission departs for Mars

bins.label: A new settlement
bins.definition: A permanent settlement or base is founded in new territory.
bins.exampleHeadline: First permanent base opens on the Moon

bins.label: A new institution
bins.definition: A body is founded that will shape the world: a school, an agency, a guild, a secret society.
bins.exampleHeadline: New agency created to oversee unexplained incidents

bins.label: States unite
bins.definition: Independent powers unite under one charter, or an empire is proclaimed.
bins.exampleHeadline: Rival nations sign charter founding a federation

bins.label: Power is seized
bins.definition: A leader or faction takes control of the state by force, decree or manoeuvre.
bins.exampleHeadline: Emergency decree hands leader unlimited powers

bins.label: War begins
bins.definition: A major war starts.
bins.exampleHeadline: Border clash escalates into open war

bins.label: A decisive victory
bins.definition: One side wins a war or a battle that settles the conflict.
bins.exampleHeadline: Offensive ends the war in weeks

bins.label: Defeat and occupation
bins.definition: A power is defeated and its territory occupied, partitioned or dissolved.
bins.exampleHeadline: Capital falls; occupying forces divide the country

bins.label: A war without end
bins.definition: A conflict settles into years of attrition, insurgency or cold war.
bins.exampleHeadline: Insurgency enters its tenth year with no end in sight

bins.label: Peace is made
bins.definition: Enemies sign a treaty, truce or alliance.
bins.exampleHeadline: Rival powers sign accord ending decades of hostility

bins.label: The ruled rise
bins.definition: A subjugated group revolts against those who hold power over it.
bins.exampleHeadline: Protests turn to insurrection in the capital

bins.label: The state cracks down
bins.definition: A government bans, disarms or attacks a group.
bins.exampleHeadline: Parliament outlaws the movement; members face arrest

bins.label: A secret is kept
bins.definition: Knowledge is hidden from the public by those who hold it.
bins.exampleHeadline: Files show officials concealed the incident for decades

bins.label: The truth comes out
bins.definition: Something hidden is exposed to the people it was hidden from.
bins.exampleHeadline: Leaked documents confirm the programme's existence

bins.label: A destined person
bins.definition: A child is born or a person is chosen on whom the future turns.
bins.exampleHeadline: First birth in eighteen years reported

bins.label: The call
bins.definition: An ordinary person is drawn into the hidden or larger story.
bins.exampleHeadline: Rookie officer pulled into secret investigation

bins.label: An arrival from another time
bins.definition: Someone or something arrives from the future or the past and changes the present.
bins.exampleHeadline: Intruder in custody claims to come from 2029

bins.label: A plague
bins.definition: A disease or biological failure kills or sterilises on a mass scale.
bins.exampleHeadline: Global pandemic declared as death toll climbs

bins.label: Mass death
bins.definition: An attack or disaster kills on a scale that changes a society.
bins.exampleHeadline: Millions dead as strikes hit the capital

bins.label: An attack
bins.definition: A targeted attack or massacre, short of war, that changes what follows.
bins.exampleHeadline: Attack inside the city leaves hundreds dead

bins.label: Civilisation collapses
bins.definition: The order of society breaks down and does not come back.
bins.exampleHeadline: Government dissolves as cities go dark

bins.label: The ruler falls
bins.definition: A ruler is killed, deposed or withdraws, and the succession is open.
bins.exampleHeadline: Leader dies suddenly; no successor named

bins.label: Beyond the human
bins.definition: A person, or humanity, passes beyond what a human being was.
bins.exampleHeadline: Accident leaves physicist with impossible abilities

bins.label: An age at its height
bins.definition: A civilisation at its peak, before the fall.
bins.exampleHeadline: Nation marks a decade of unbroken prosperity

bins.label: Long after
bins.definition: A jump forward shows what became of the world.
bins.exampleHeadline: Fifty years on, survivors return to the abandoned city
